name: Ally of the Tauren
label: Quest
description: Ally of the Tauren: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Elder Crone has sent me to this warzone to research the other races. More specifically, I am to collect gnome samples. Magatha is primarily interested in their survivability. Aye, the gnomes - while pitifully weak and miniscule - exude great resilience both in and out of combat.
Fortunately for you, I am looking for ruffians to do Magatha's bidding. Return to me with tufts of gnome hair and you shall be known to the tauren as an ally.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I don't care where the hair comes from, traveler.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aye, this is definitely gnome. Well done, traveler, but there is more work to be done.
